title: feat(console): build a new report from the design mode's Add menu item
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ89Betg8QPoUPD5NhDenSfS2)_
Fixes #36364
Clause-②: yes (widening) — three new `@object-ui/i18n` keys (`designMode.menu.newReport`, `designMode.menu.newReportLeft`, `report.builder.addsToMenu`) in all 11 locales; no spec, schema or public export change
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXq2Dxb31zZNmSqCtz

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在设计模式里「添加菜单项 → 报表」，第一行是「新建报表…」，点了会占好菜单位置并打开报表搭建页；选好数据来源和指标、保存后，新报表出现在占好的位置，设计模式里的其他改动一起保存。
- 为什么做：设计模式专题卡的报表这一半，按席位定的方案：报表必须先有数据来源和指标，所以从搭建页新建，而不是只填名字。
- 出错会怎样：菜单保存失败时，刚建的报表会被删掉，设计模式和搭建页都保持打开；中途关闭搭建页或离开它，什么都不写、占位消失；可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么：不用做什么。

## What changes

The report half of #36364, on top of the report builder (#36644), per the seat's ruling (option A, comment 7090058961): a report needs `dataset` and `values`, so 「New report…」 opens the builder, and the report and its menu entry are written only when the builder saves.

- **Picker** (`DesignModeMenu.tsx`): the Reports list starts with 「New report…」. It holds the place (the dashed row now reads 「New report…」), offers a slot, and navigates to the app's `reports/new`. Nothing is written.
- **The slot** (`designModeReportSlot.ts`, new): the menu lives in the sidebar and the builder in the page, with no shared tree, so a module-level store holds one slot `{ path, save, cancel }`. It is keyed by the builder's address, not the app's name, because the console addresses an app by its route segment (the showcase app is `/apps/com.example.showcase`, its name `showcase_app`). This was found on the live run, and a page test pins it. The menu withdraws the slot when the place is dropped and when it unmounts (the design mode ended). Without a slot the builder is the plain new-report page, as before.
- **The builder page** (`ReportNewPage.tsx`): when a slot waits on its address, it says 「Saving creates this report and adds it to the menu where you placed it, with your other design changes.」. Its Save hands `(name, label, body)` to the slot and writes nothing itself. A refused save keeps the builder open. Its Close cancels the place and goes back.
- **The save** (`designModeMenuCreate.ts`): `NewMenuItem` gains a `report` arm carrying the builder's body. `saveAppMenuWithNewItem` runs the dashboard half's order unchanged: every menu-save check first, then the report saved and published in the menu's own package (`saveAndPublishInPackage`, the package-bound door `saveDashboardInPlace` now shares), then the menu written with the entry in the held place and every other staged edit (`saveWith`). On a refused menu the report is removed again.
- **Leaving the builder another way** (a menu link, Back) drops the held place too, so no row waits for a builder that is gone.
- **The entry's label**: a report entry with no `label` shows its machine name (only object, view and dashboard entries inherit their target's label, per the cloud#2021 ruling), so the new entry carries the report's label. The live run first showed `hui_kuan_fenxi` in the menu, and this fixes it.

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportNewPage` at `f3021225`: `Test Files 157 passed (157)`, `Tests 1284 passed (1284)`. `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx` was rerun at head `ecbe0f66` after the label change: `38 passed`. Earlier at `f7737e36`, `packages/i18n` gave `1978 passed`, with the de quote-pairing count raised 128 → 129 for `newReportLeft`'s „{{name}}“.
- New pins:
  - `designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts`: 4 report cases. They cover the body, the package write order (ensure → save/publish report → save/publish app), a refused menu resetting the report, and an unlisted package creating nothing.
  - `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx`: 5 report cases. They cover the picker row holding the place and writing nothing; the builder's Save writing the report, then the menu with the labelled entry and the other staged edit, then leaving the mode; a refused menu; the builder's Close; and leaving the builder.
  - `ReportNewPage.menuSlot-36364.test.tsx`: 5 cases. They cover Save going through the slot; a refused save staying open; Close cancelling and going back; a route segment other than the app's name; and another app's slot not being used.
- Ablations (one-shot, not kept): without the page change, the page file went 3 failed | 1 passed. Without the menu change, all 5 menu report cases were red.
- `tsc --noEmit` (app-shell) exit 0. ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors. `check-i18n-call-site-keys` exit 0.

## Screenshots

Taken on the live showcase example (fresh backend, console dev server, zh-CN, deviceScaleFactor 2). They are stored with the seat's project files (`issue-36364/`):

1. 「添加菜单项 → 报表」, with 「新建报表…」 first.
2. The builder, with the held 「新建报表…」 row under 数据分析 and the 「adds to the menu」 line.
3. The builder filled: Invoice Metrics, grouped by status, named 回款分析.
4. After Save: the design mode is left, and 「回款分析」 sits in the held place, open.
5. Cancel path: a second 「新建报表…」, closed from the builder. The page goes back, no held row is left, and the mode stays on.

Checked through the API after the run:
- `report/hui_kuan_fenxi` is stored in `com.example.showcase.custom`, the menu's package (the same item Studio lists), with `_diagnostics.valid: true`.
- The app's menu holds `{ id: nav_item_1, type: report, reportName: hui_kuan_fenxi, label: 回款分析 }` under `grp_analytics`.
- It is the only `hui_kuan*` report, so the cancelled build left nothing.

## Overlap

`overlap-check`: merges cleanly with main, #36655 and #36525. With #36629 it conflicts only in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`, because both PRs raise the same German quote count. Whichever lands second re-adds 1 to the count.
